inputs.text: [happily] Ready to travel back in time? [pauses] Let's start [excited] at the very beginning...
[chuckles] Oh yes. [happily] Way, way before. [serious] Almost four billion years ago. [pauses] The Earth is hot and empty. [serious] No animals. No plants. Nothing at all.
[softly] Not even a bug. [pauses] Then, in the water, [happily] something teeny-tiny appears. [curious] A bacterium, [softly] so small you can't even see it.
[playful] Then? [quickly] Algae, soft little worms, jellyfish, coral, [excited] tiny animals with shells, [happily] and the very first fish.
[curious] And all of that lives only in the water?
[happily] Yes. [serious] There's still no life on dry land at all. [excited] Then one day, an animal crawls out of the water, [softly] a bit like a big salamander, with four legs.
[curious] What about plants? Did they come out of the water too?

[happily] They did, even a little earlier. [softly] Simple mosses first, then ferns. [happily] They grow on dry land, and it turns green. [gasps] So the four-legged animals have something to eat, [excited] and they move right in.
[playful] Of course. [pauses] In the water, big fish ate little fish. [excited] And on land, big four-legged animals ate little insects. [serious] There have always been meat-eaters and plant-eaters.
[happily] Next, we jump forward in time. [excited] Millions of years go by. [gasps] And then… [chuckles] want to hear what happens?
